mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_article (title, content, summary, category_id, cover_image, author_id, author_name, related_resource_id, related_resource_title, status, is_top, is_recommend, is_original) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{categoryId}, #{coverImage}, #{authorId}, #{authorName}, #{relatedResourceId}, #{relatedResourceTitle}, #{status}, #{isTop}, #{isRecommend}, #{isOriginal})
mapper.update:
UPDATE my_article
title = #{title},
content = #{content},
summary = #{summary},
category_id = #{categoryId},
cover_image = #{coverImage},
related_resource_id = #{relatedResourceId},
related_resource_title = #{relatedResourceTitle},
status = #{status},
is_top = #{isTop},
is_recommend = #{isRecommend},
is_original = #{isOriginal},
publish_time = #{publishTime},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE my_article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE my_article SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
UPDATE my_article SET collect_count = collect_count + 1 WHERE article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_view_record (article_id, user_id, view_time) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_time = NOW()
